categories.evidence: Touches test/functional/p2p_tx_download.py, which tests P2P transaction request and download behavior.
categories.rationale: Fixes an intermittent test failure in P2P transaction download testing caused by unmocked time on node 1. Because node 1's time was not mocked, advancing wall-clock time could trigger requests to an unresponsive peer and cause mempool sync to fail.
